meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.coverage: Sources of money stock (M3): bank credit to government and the commercial sector, foreign exchange assets, every reporting fortnight since 1951, as the RBI Bulletin prints them
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 23 (data provider DP0), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. One display unit kept (ACTUALS). Amounts in ₹ crore. 7 cells the source prints more than once with different values (1956-03-23, 1962-03-30, 1965-03-26, 1968-03-22 and other dates) are left out: we cannot tell which value is right. Left out as printed in the wrong unit (36 values, e.g. 1.1.2.1 Central Government on 2002-03-31; 1.1.2.1 Central Government on 2011-03-25; 1.1.2.1 Central Government on 2012-10-19).
